```yaml
name: Bump personal server after release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout personal server repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          ref: main
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: personal-server

      - name: Get release tag
        id: get_tag
        run: echo "TAG=${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set variables
        id: vars
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.TAG }}
        run: |
          echo "branch_name=bump-${TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "title=Bump personal server to ${TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "body=Automated bump of personal server to match Hush Line release." >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Bump version in files
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.branch_name }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.get_tag.outputs.TAG }}
        run: |
          VERSION=${TAG#v}
          # Update DEBIAN/control
          sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: $VERSION/" personal-server/DEBIAN/control
          # Update docker-compose.yaml
          sed -i "s|image: .*|image: hushline:$VERSION|" personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          # Commit changes
          cd personal-server
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          git add DEBIAN/control var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git commit -m "Bump personal server to $VERSION"
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Create pull request
        id: create_pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: personal-server
          branch: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.branch_name }}
          title: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.title }}
          body: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.body }}
          base: main
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Merge pull request
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.create_pr.outputs.pr_number }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          script: |
            const prNumber = process.env.PR_NUMBER;
            if (prNumber) {
              await github.rest.pulls.merge({
                owner: 'scidsg',
                repo: 'hushline-personal-server',
                pull_number: prNumber,
                merge_method: 'squash'
              });
            }
```
